description: Sends the same prompt to 2-4 models in parallel and returns the answers side by side with tokens, latency and estimated cost for each. Good for a second (or third) opinion on code, a design decision or a fact. Paid: each model counts as one call toward the session cap.

max_tokens.description: Maximum answer length per model (default 1024, cap 4096).

models.description: 2-4 different model ids, e.g. ["deepseek-v4.1-flash", "glm-5.3"]. See list_models.

prompt.description: The question or task (self-contained: the models cannot see this conversation).

system.description: Optional system prompt sent to every model.

name: compare_models
title: Bandingkan model / Compare models
